verdict.rationale: DBOS has a dedicated upgrade guide stating it supports two strategies for safely upgrading workflow code, patching and versioning (dbos-docs-10). Conductor is also marketed as able to version durable workflows (dbos-docs-21), and the docs acknowledge that long-waiting workflows must survive software upgrades (dbos-docs-12). However, the pack contains only one-line claims, with no detail on how in-flight runs are pinned to their starting version or how determinism is preserved. Missing for 10: documented mechanics of routing in-flight runs to the old code version, how patching keeps replay deterministic, rollout/retirement of old versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
